method: Nineteen performance/diversity/frequency roles fixed from the expanded finite study. Positive total return, <=40% portfolio drawdown, >=20 fills (18 only for the 30bp endpoint). Two small-size roles retain a 1:1 endpoint; the full-session reversal has a >=1:100 risk endpoint. Prefer 20% among identical nonbinding stops. Keep >=75% of each role’s best log-return/(0.05+DD)+0.5*log-return, then balance 55% relative quality/45% minimum parameter distance. Ten higher-frequency roles are deliberate. Capacity counts are frozen from the pre-change review; no unrelated incumbent is displaced. All history has been inspected; this is not validation.
